Glasgow

Sunday 13 December 2026

On Sunday 13 December, the cyclo-cross peloton makes the trip to Glasgow in Scotland. In Kelvingrove Park, Great Britain makes its comeback on the UCI World Cup calendar. Who will be crowned the winner in the third round of the season?

Please note, the timings in the program are local time in Glasgow (GMT +1).
